title: On Admitting the fault at once
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：admit　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 admit 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the grower ① admitted the fault at once without complaint, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② admits the fault at once with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ admit the fault at once at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ admitted the fault at once before — a line in the ledger for August 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Admitting the fault at once without complaint, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ admit two visitors after dark with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Admit two visitors after dark at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ admits two visitors after dark without complaint every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply  admitted the fault at once again when nobody else would.

To admit the fault at once, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody admits the fault at once with great care again and somebody must admit the fault at once without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 承认（一般过去式 admitted the fault at once：1957 年种植户头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 承认（一般现在 admits the fault at once：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 承认（不定式 to admit the fault at once：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 承认（过去完成时 had admitted the fault at once：1951 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 承认（动名词 admitting the fault at once 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 准许进入（admit two visitors after dark：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去准许进入天黑后来访的两位客人）
G. v. 准许进入（admit two visitors after dark：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 承认（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 admits two visitors after dark，而母亲又一次 admitted the fault at once）

items.q: to admit the fault at once
admitted the fault at once before
admit two visitors after dark with great care
admit two visitors after dark at once
admits two visitors after dark without complaint

answers.why: admit 意为“承认”，1957 年种植户毫无怨言地承认当场认了那个过失，那是大棚里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 admitted。
admit 意为“承认”，自那以后种植户小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 admits。
admit 意为“承认”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯承认当场认了那个过失”，此处为不定式 to admit the fault at once。
admit 意为“承认”，收成账里 八月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人承认过，故用过去完成时 had admitted。
admit 意为“承认”，种植户说“承认当场认了那个过失这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 admitting the fault at once 作主语。
admit 意为“准许进入”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去准许进入天黑后来访的两位客人”，should ever 之后用原形 admit two visitors after dark。
admit 意为“准许进入”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻准许进入天黑后来访的两位客人（admit two visitors after dark at once），以后再也不要提起。
admit 意为“承认”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例准许进入天黑后来访的两位客人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 admits。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，种植户毫无怨言地承认当场认了那个过失；大棚里每一个收购人都说这是头一回。（admitted the fault at once）
多年以后，种植户仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（admits the fault at once）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯承认当场认了那个过失这件事本身。（to admit the fault at once）
早在 1951 年就有人承认当场认了那个过失，八月那天收成账上的一行字就是证据。（had admitted the fault at once）
种植户说过，毫无怨言地承认当场认了那个过失这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（admitting the fault at once 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻准许进入天黑后来访的两位客人，以后再也不要提起。（admit two visitors after dark，祈使句）
answers: In 1957 the grower admitted the fault at once without complaint, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three summers on, the grower still admits the fault at once with great care without being asked.
My mother said later that to admit the fault at once at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had admitted the fault at once long before 1964, and the line in the ledger for August proves it.
Admitting the fault at once without complaint, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Admit two visitors after dark at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 admit 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the grower admitted the fault at once without complaint, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower admits the fault at once with great care whenever the greenhouse asks.
Admitting the fault at once without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever admit two visitors after dark with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse admits two visitors after dark without complaint every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother admitted the fault at once again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
